targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE state WHEN 'success' THEN 1 WHEN 'running' THEN 2 WHEN 'queued' THEN 3 WHEN 'failed' THEN 4 ELSE 9 END FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' ORDER BY execution_date DESC LIMIT 1), 0)::double precision AS state
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(logical_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')) * 1000 AS logical_date FROM control.ingestion_batches WHERE pipeline_name = '${pipeline_name}' AND status = 'completed'

SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - updated_at)) / 3600.0, 999999) AS hours FROM (SELECT updated_at FROM control.pipeline_watermarks WHERE pipeline_name = '${pipeline_name}' LIMIT 1) w RIGHT JOIN (SELECT 1) present ON true
SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(end_date, now()) - start_date)), 0) AS seconds FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' ORDER BY execution_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) AS percent FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' AND execution_date >= now() - interval '7 days'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS batches FROM control.ingestion_batches WHERE pipeline_name = '${pipeline_name}' AND (status = 'failed' OR (status IN ('started','ingested') AND started_at < now() - interval '60 minutes'))

panels.title: High-severity DQ rows
panels.description: Current-state snapshot, not historical dbt-test results.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(affected_row_count), 0) AS affected_rows FROM silver.data_quality_report WHERE severity = 'high'

SELECT execution_date AS "Logical date (UTC)", run_id AS "Run ID", run_type AS "Run type", state AS "State", queued_at AS "Queued", start_date AS "Started", end_date AS "Ended", ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(end_date, now()) - start_date))::numeric, 1) AS "Duration (s)" FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' AND $__timeFilter(execution_date) ORDER BY execution_date DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT execution_date AS time, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(end_date, now()) - start_date)) AS value FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' AND start_date IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(execution_date) ORDER BY execution_date

SELECT date_trunc('day', execution_date) AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'success')::double precision AS success, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'failed')::double precision AS failed FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' AND $__timeFilter(execution_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT execution_date AS "Logical date (UTC)", run_id AS "Run ID", state AS "State", start_date AS "Started", end_date AS "Ended" FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' AND state = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(execution_date) ORDER BY execution_date DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Latest run task states
panels.description: Skipped tasks are neutral: expected when the matching batch is already completed.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT run_id FROM dag_run WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' ORDER BY execution_date DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT ti.task_id AS "Task ID", ti.state AS "State", ti.try_number AS "Try", ti.start_date AS "Started", ti.end_date AS "Ended", ROUND(ti.duration::numeric, 1) AS "Duration (s)" FROM task_instance ti JOIN latest l USING (run_id) WHERE ti.dag_id = '${dag_id}' ORDER BY ti.task_id LIMIT 100

SELECT dr.execution_date AS time, ti.duration AS value, ti.task_id AS metric FROM task_instance ti JOIN dag_run dr ON dr.dag_id = ti.dag_id AND dr.run_id = ti.run_id WHERE ti.dag_id = '${dag_id}' AND ti.duration IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(dr.execution_date) ORDER BY dr.execution_date

SELECT dr.execution_date AS "Logical date (UTC)", ti.run_id AS "Run ID", ti.task_id AS "Task ID", ti.state AS "State", ti.try_number AS "Try", ti.start_date AS "Started", ti.end_date AS "Ended" FROM task_instance ti JOIN dag_run dr ON dr.dag_id = ti.dag_id AND dr.run_id = ti.run_id WHERE ti.dag_id = '${dag_id}' AND ti.state IN ('failed','upstream_failed','up_for_retry') AND $__timeFilter(dr.execution_date) ORDER BY dr.execution_date DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT ti.task_id AS task, SUM(GREATEST(ti.try_number - 1, 0))::bigint AS retries FROM task_instance ti JOIN dag_run dr ON dr.dag_id = ti.dag_id AND dr.run_id = ti.run_id WHERE ti.dag_id = '${dag_id}' AND $__timeFilter(dr.execution_date) GROUP BY ti.task_id ORDER BY retries DESC

SELECT logical_date AS "Logical date", status AS "Status", started_at AS "Started", completed_at AS "Completed", ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(completed_at, now()) - started_at))::numeric, 1) AS "Duration (s)", rows_received AS "Received", rows_inserted AS "Inserted", rows_updated AS "Updated", rows_deleted AS "Deleted", rows_rejected AS "Rejected", error_message AS "Error" FROM control.ingestion_batches WHERE pipeline_name = '${pipeline_name}' AND $__timeFilter(logical_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY logical_date DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Latest volume vs trailing 7
panels.description: Operational heuristic: only shown with 7 prior completed batches; below 50% is unusual, not proof of bad data.

targets.rawSql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT logical_date, rows_received, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY logical_date DESC) AS rn FROM control.ingestion_batches WHERE pipeline_name = '${pipeline_name}' AND status = 'completed'), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(rows_received) AS avg_rows, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ranked WHERE rn BETWEEN 2 AND 8), latest AS (SELECT rows_received FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1) SELECT CASE WHEN baseline.n = 7 THEN ROUND(100.0 * latest.rows_received / NULLIF(baseline.avg_rows, 0), 1) END AS percent FROM latest CROSS JOIN baseline

SELECT batch_id AS "Batch ID", logical_date AS "Logical date", status AS "Status", started_at AS "Started", error_message AS "Error" FROM control.ingestion_batches WHERE pipeline_name = '${pipeline_name}' AND status <> 'completed' ORDER BY logical_date DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT logical_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time, rows_received::double precision AS received, rows_inserted::double precision AS inserted, rows_updated::double precision AS updated, rows_deleted::double precision AS deleted, rows_rejected::double precision AS rejected FROM control.ingestion_batches WHERE pipeline_name = '${pipeline_name}' AND $__timeFilter(logical_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY logical_date

SELECT logical_date AS "Logical date", source_file AS "Source file", LEFT(file_checksum, 12) AS "Checksum", status AS "Status", rows_received AS "Received", rows_inserted AS "Inserted", rows_updated AS "Updated", rows_deleted AS "Deleted", rows_rejected AS "Rejected", completed_at AS "Completed" FROM control.ingested_files WHERE pipeline_name = '${pipeline_name}' ORDER BY logical_date DESC, source_file LIMIT 100

panels.title: Watermark current state
panels.description: Current state only; timestamps are stored in UTC and displayed in Asia/Jakarta.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pipeline_name AS "Pipeline", last_logical_date AS "Last logical date", batch_id AS "Batch ID", last_source_updated_at AS "Last source update", updated_at AS "Watermark updated", ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - updated_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 1) AS "Age (hours)" FROM control.pipeline_watermarks WHERE pipeline_name = '${pipeline_name}'

panels.title: Current data-quality issues
panels.description: Current snapshot. Historical dbt-test detail remains in the Airflow dbt_test task logs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT table_name AS "Table", issue_type AS "Issue", severity AS "Severity", affected_row_count AS "Affected rows" FROM silver.data_quality_report ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, affected_row_count DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT severity, SUM(affected_row_count)::bigint AS affected_rows FROM silver.data_quality_report GROUP BY severity ORDER BY affected_rows DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(affected_row_count), 0) AS affected_rows FROM silver.data_quality_report WHERE severity = 'high'
SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - MAX(latest_heartbeat))), 999999) AS seconds FROM job WHERE job_type = 'SchedulerJob' AND state = 'running'
SELECT CASE WHEN is_paused THEN 'paused' WHEN is_active THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END AS state FROM dag WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' LIMIT 1
SELECT CASE WHEN has_import_errors THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS errors FROM dag WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - last_parsed_time)), 999999) AS seconds FROM dag WHERE dag_id = '${dag_id}' LIMIT 1
